notes:
disagreement: value: the service update's service_name cell: one pass tests it as the benchmark does, the other relies on the anchor alone; kept it, since the benchmark check tests it and nothing contradicts it (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the new rule's skill predicates: one pass matches 'Payroll' and 'Time Tracking' anywhere in based_on_skills, the other matches them as quoted names; chose the quoted form, since the seed stores the skills as a JSON array of quoted names (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the stay on the other services' criteria: one pass holds the count of other services with no criterion at 53, the other the count with a criterion at 0; chose the count at 0, since it measures exactly the change the request forbids (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the stay on rule 4 (HR Payroll Case): one pass tests its group and active flag, the other also its name, country and skills; chose the tighter form, since a change to its country or skills would also alter routing, and all its cells hold on the seed (resolved on that requirement).
The passes otherwise agree on every requirement, id, cell and disposition (three checks kept, one repaired); their texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
Secure Case Access (group 12) belongs to organisation 2 while the acting user belongs to organisation 1; the request names that group and the seed already holds criteria pointing at groups of other organisations, so group 12 is required as written.
'Only' the Secure Case Access group having access could also mean the criterion's users list is empty, but users is JSON and every seed row holds NULL, so the stored form of an empty list is unknown; it is left untested.
The article's title and body are not tested: the request quotes no title, the policy's title template is a format rule the benchmark does not test, and the body's required explanations (when to apply the criterion, how the skill and country routing works) have no fixed wording.
hr_service has no group column, so other services' group targeting is covered by the stay on rule 4, the existing rule for GB cases needing Payroll and Time Tracking. The closing instruction to verify the configuration by checking the updated service is a read and changes no row.
